title: Проклятие

words.ex: There was a long wound across his arm.
words.ex_ru: На его руке была длинная рана.

words.ex: Our mother cursed us when we were children.
words.ex_ru: Наша мать прокляла нас, когда мы были детьми.

words.ex: They were close enough to kiss.
words.ex_ru: Они были так близко, что могли бы поцеловаться.
Я должен кое в чём признаться.

story: Only when they were back in her room did Mira see the blood. The wolf had reached Ash before it reached her. There was a long wound across his arm, and it was still bleeding.
“Sit,” she ordered. “I worked in a tavern for six years. I know how to clean a cut.”
He looked surprised, but he sat. Her hands were trembling as she washed the wound. Under the fresh blood she saw old scars — dozens of thin silver lines.
For a long time he did not answer. Then he said, “If I tell you the truth, you will be in even more danger.”
“I am already in danger. Tell me.”

“Our mother cursed us when we were children. Corin and me. As long as we both live, neither of us can wear the crown. One of us must die. That is why he wants to kill me.” He touched the scars. “And that is why, many times, I have tried to kill him.”
Mira was quiet. She thought about Bram, and her grandmother, and the coin in her pocket.
“Will the wound heal?” she asked finally.
“Fae heal fast.” His voice was gentle. “Mortals do not. You should hate me. I brought you here.”
“I know.” She tied a clean cloth around his arm. “I don't.”
He took her hand. For a moment they were very close, close enough to kiss. Then he let go.
“I must confess something,” he said. “I did not choose you because you can touch iron. I chose you because, at the tavern, you were kind to a stranger. I had forgotten what that looks like.”
“Then you are forgiven,” she said. “For now.”

questions.q: Why does Mira know how to clean a cut?
o: She worked in a tavern for six years

questions.q: What did their mother do to Ash and Corin?
o: She sent them to the mortal world

questions.q: Why can't the brothers wear the crown?

o: She was kind to a stranger

grammar.title: Если…: if + настоящее, will + глагол
grammar.text:
Условие о будущем: if + настоящее время, а в главной части — will.

If I tell you the truth, you will be in even more danger — «Если я скажу тебе правду, ты будешь в ещё большей опасности».

Внимание: после if по-английски не ставят will, хотя по-русски там будущее («если скажу» = if I tell).

Ещё из главы: have tried — «пытался (и это важно сейчас)»: I have tried to kill him. Это время Present Perfect: have/has + третья форма.
